name: CIA Chat
annotation: HIFI-09 · /ai-coach · dark shell (#0A0A0F) + top-center amber radial glow; ChatComposer is the dominant focal moment fixed above GlassNavBar; CIA glass bubbles carry cross-domain synthesis, user turns are solid orange, and every claim carries provenance or honest-null.

modules.build: Transparent until scroll; left title 'CIA.' (H1 30); right icons search, mic (44px targets); top-center amber radial glow rgba(255,94,0,.18).

Overline 'today' centered, uppercase 11. CIA glass bubble below (white 4.5% fill, border white 8%, r24): 'CIA  Good morning, Amira. Your *sleep* and workout load are connected.' (Body 15; *sleep* Newsreader Medium Italic, purple #7F24FF).

InlineArtifactCard, glass r28, purple #7F24FF synth glow top-left. Title 'Connection spotted' (H3 20). Row 'sleep 6h 12m' + ChipProvenance 'via Health'. Row 'workout load 8/10' + ChipProvenance 'via you logged'. ChipDomainTag '[fitness]' (orange 16% bg), '[wellbeing]' (green 16% bg).
User bubble, solid #FF5E00: 'You  What should I change today?' (Body 15, paper text). Below: 'CIA is thinking...' caption 12, muted, opacity pulse.
Horizontal scroll suggestion chips: '(tell me more)', '(show goals)', '(log meal)' — glass pills, border white 8%, 44px targets; selected chip fills orange then becomes a user message.

ChatComposer fixed above GlassNavBar, glass r28: text input placeholder 'message CIA'; right icon mic with VoiceMicGlow (purple #7F24FF); dims 40% when offline, rate-limited, permission-blocked, or a destructive sheet is open.
GlassNavBar floating pill (dark glass): 'Today', 'CIA' (active, orange #FF5E00 underline/glow), 'Goals', 'Me' — 44px targets.

belowFold: Older conversation history (scroll-up): day separators, CIA glass bubbles, user orange bubbles, and InlineArtifactCards continue above the visible thread; pull-to-load gesture at top.
Skeleton state while older history or cards load: message rows and artifact geometry shimmer in final geometry, never a spinner-only placeholder.
imageSlots: HIFI-09-01 — CIA chat avatar (36px circle in CIA bubble header or top bar); premium warm-dark glass UI asset, privacy-safe, no brand logos, no readable UI text; fallback initial 'C' in purple #7F24FF circle.
trustControls: Long-press message opens action Sheet: audience, visibility, report, mute, block, own-content delete.
Tap ChipProvenance opens source sheet: category, source, scope, freshness, retention, export, revoke, delete, and 'why CIA used this' explanation.
Tap mic triggers ConsentCard naming microphone, transcript, retention, export, revoke, delete before capture.
Low-confidence synthesis labelled 'estimated · low confidence', muted; no cross-domain insight card renders when fewer than two evidence chips exist (honest-null).
notes:
Shell: dark #0A0A0F + top-center orange radial rgba(255,94,0,.18); selective glass on CIA bubbles, artifact, composer, and nav — dense/solid elsewhere.
Composer is the dominant focal moment — one visually singular element, not one tile among many.
Type: Hanken Grotesk for UI; one Newsreader Medium Italic emphasis word, *sleep*, in the first CIA message.
Disabled: composer dims 40% when offline, rate-limited, permission-blocked, or a destructive action sheet is open.
Offline: cached history stays readable; sends queue only on explicit retry; OfflineBanner shown; composer dimmed.
Error: failed sends, logs, cards, and pull-to-load failures each preserve existing history and expose retry/delete inline.
Contrast: paper text on chat bubbles and dark base clears AA+; composer, send, mic, chips, TopBar glyphs, artifact cards, and nav meet 44px targets.
